rationale.consistency: Follows standard Go idioms, avoids external dependencies, and integrates cleanly with the existing changePath callback pattern.
rationale.edge_cases: EqualFold on single bytes equates all continuation bytes (breaking UTF-8); aborts on invalid escapes instead of treating the '%' literally.
rationale.scope: Applies EqualFold to the entire comparison, making the path matching case-insensitive and violating the requirement to preserve existing behavior.
rationale.readability: The reverse byte-by-byte parsing loop is complex but well-commented, with clear variable names and a logical structure.
rationale.robustness: Prevents out-of-bounds slice panics and gracefully falls back to the original path if url.PathUnescape fails, ensuring safe execution.
rationale.maintainability: The low-level reverse byte loop is brittle; fixing the case-sensitivity and UTF-8 bugs requires complex state tracking or a full rewrite.
